results.title: Home page renders
results.expected: Hero h1 and featured sections render; no runtime errors
results.actual: h1="Single-Origin Chocolate, Crafted With Intention", h2 count=3, page errors=0

results.title: Desktop primary navigation
results.steps: Click each header nav link (Shop, Wholesale, Build a Sampler, Contact, About)
results.expected: Each link changes URL and renders that page h1
results.actual: Shop->/shop h1="Shop"; Wholesale->/b2b h1="Custom Chocolate for Business"; Build a Sampler->/sampler h1="Build Your Own Sampler"; Contact->/contact h1="Get in Touch"; About->/about h1="Chocolate, Crafted With Intent"

results.title: Direct load / refresh of every route
results.pre: SPA fallback server (index.html for unknown paths)
results.steps: Load each route URL directly, then reload
results.expected: Each route renders its page (not blank, not 404) after a direct load and a reload
results.actual: /:ok, /shop:ok, /product/1:ok, /cart:ok, /checkout:ok, /sampler:ok, /b2b:ok, /b2b/custom-order:ok, /contact:ok, /about:ok (Server-side rewrite on UTA Cloud not verifiable from this sandbox)

results.title: Browser back/forward
results.steps: Home -> Shop -> Product 1; Back; Back; Forward
results.expected: History navigation restores the matching page each time

results.title: 404 handling
results.expected: Not-found page with a Back to Home link for both
results.actual: /does-not-exist h1="Page Not Found"; /product/999 h1="Page Not Found"; home link=1

results.title: Footer links and logo
results.steps: Click each footer link, then the header logo
results.expected: Each footer link reaches its route; logo returns to /

results.title: Mobile navigation menu
results.steps: Tap menu button, tap "Contact"; reopen and press Escape
results.expected: Menu opens as dialog, link navigates and closes menu; Escape closes

results.title: Catalog lists all products
results.expected: 9 product cards with name, origin, cacao %, price and Add to Cart

results.title: Header search
results.expected: Navigates to /shop?search=Ecuador and shows only matching product(s)

results.title: Search with no matches
results.expected: Empty-state message shown, no cards

results.title: Category filter (incl. Home category tile)
results.steps: Home: click "Artisanal Truffles" tile; then on /shop click "Seasonal Collections"
results.expected: Truffles: 3 products, URL ?category=truffle; Seasonal: 2 products

results.title: Origin filter
results.expected: Peru: 2 products; Peru+Ghana: 3 products

results.title: Cacao % slider
results.steps: Set cacao slider to 70 (keyboard: Right x6)
results.expected: Only products with cacao >= 70% shown (4 products)

results.title: Max price slider
results.steps: Set price slider to $13 (keyboard: Left x17)
results.expected: Only products priced <= $13 shown (4 products)

results.title: Sorting
results.expected: Price asc/desc and cacao desc order the grid correctly

results.title: Combined filters, empty state and Clear filters
results.steps: Origin Ghana + cacao >= 70 -> empty; click Clear filters
results.expected: Empty-state message, then all 9 products after clearing
results.actual: empty state=True; after clear=9 cards, url=/shop

results.title: Mobile filter drawer
results.expected: Drawer opens within viewport; filter applies; Escape closes

results.title: Product detail content and related items
results.expected: Name, origin, cacao %, SKU, description, price and up to 3 related products of the same type
results.actual: h1="Madagascar Single-Origin 72%", meta="MADAGASCAR · 72% CACAO · SKU SC-BAR-001", related=3

results.title: Quantity selector and add to cart
results.steps: On /product/2: + twice, - once, + once (qty 3), Add to Cart
results.expected: Quantity floors at 1; cart badge 3; drawer subtotal = 3 x $13.75 = $41.25

results.title: Add from product card opens drawer
results.steps: On /shop click Add to Cart on first card
results.expected: Badge shows 1; drawer opens listing the item and subtotal $12.50

results.title: Quantity controls in drawer
results.expected: Same line increments (qty 2), +/- update qty, badge and subtotal; qty cannot go below 1

results.title: Remove item and empty state
results.expected: Item removed, empty message shown, badge hidden, checkout link removed

results.title: Cart page lines and totals
results.steps: Add products 1 ($12.50) and 4 ($24.00); open /cart; increase product 4 to 2
results.expected: Line totals $12.50 and $48.00; subtotal $60.50

results.title: Drawer close controls and checkout link
results.steps: Close via X; reopen, Continue Shopping; reopen, click Checkout
results.expected: Each close control closes drawer; Checkout link navigates to /checkout and closes drawer

results.title: Empty cart page
results.expected: Empty message and Continue Shopping link to /shop

results.title: Empty-cart checkout prevented
results.expected: Place Order disabled when cart is empty

results.title: Required fields on empty submit
results.steps: Click Place Order with all fields empty
results.expected: All 11 fields show an error; no navigation

results.title: First/last name validation
results.steps: Enter values in First Name and blur
results.expected: Reject numeric-only and symbols; accept accents, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes

results.title: State/province validation
results.steps: Enter values in State and blur
results.expected: Accept abbreviations and names; reject numeric

results.title: Phone validation
results.steps: Enter values in Phone and blur
results.expected: Accept international/formatted numbers with 7-15 digits; reject letters and too few digits

results.title: Email validation
results.steps: Enter values in Email and blur
results.expected: Reject malformed addresses; accept valid

results.title: Expiry cannot be in the past
results.steps: Enter a past month, current month, next year
results.expected: Past month rejected; current and future accepted

results.title: CVC validation
results.steps: Enter values in CVC and blur
results.expected: Accept 3 or 4 digits; reject 2 digits and letters

results.title: Errors clear when corrected; error association
results.steps: Blur empty Email, then type valid email
results.expected: Error appears with aria-invalid and aria-describedby, then clears on correction

results.title: Valid order reaches confirmation and clears cart
results.steps: Fill all fields with valid dummy data and submit
results.expected: Navigates to /order-confirmation with an order reference; cart cleared. (Mock: no payment or backend call.)

results.title: Order reference stays stable
results.steps: On confirmation page toggle language EN->ES->EN
results.expected: The displayed order reference does not change

results.title: Confirmation page without an order
results.expected: Does not claim an order was placed (no success message / fake reference)
results.actual:
page shows: "Thank You for Your Order!

A confirmation has been sent to your email. Your chocolates are"

results.title: Login modal (mock auth)
results.steps: Click Log In, submit empty; fill email+password; submit
results.expected: Native required validation blocks empty submit; login closes modal and shows account link. Mock: no credential check.
results.actual: blocked empty=True, modal closed=True, account link="test.buyer"

results.title: Register view and account type
results.steps: Open modal, switch to Create Your Account, choose Business, submit
results.expected: Register form shows First Name and account type; account page shows Business / Wholesale

results.title: Account route guard
results.expected: Redirects to / when not logged in

results.title: Order history (sample data)
results.expected: Shows sample-data notice and 2 sample orders with totals (frontend mock; real orders are a Phase 3 dependency)

results.title: Saved addresses: validation, save, persistence, remove
results.steps: Add Address: submit empty; city "12345"; valid save; reload + log in again; remove
results.expected: Errors for empty/invalid; saved address listed; persists in localStorage per email; removable
results.actual: empty errors=6, numeric city error=1, saved=1, after reload+login=1, removed=True

results.title: Logout; auth after refresh
results.steps: Click Log Out on account page; separately log in and reload
results.expected: Logout returns to logged-out header. After reload user is logged out (documented mock behaviour; persistent sessions are Phase 3)
results.actual: logged out after Log Out=True; logged out after reload=True (mock, in-memory auth)

results.title: Select, deselect and totals
results.expected: Count/total 3/9 & $50.25, then 2/9 & $36.50; aria-pressed reflects selection
results.actual: after select=('3 / 9 pieces selected', 50.25); after deselect=('2 / 9 pieces selected', 36.5); aria-pressed=true count=2

results.title: Empty sampler cannot be added
results.expected: Add button disabled; prompt to choose pieces

results.title: Add sampler to cart
results.steps: Select products 1,4,9; click Add to Sampler
results.expected: Cart gets 3 lines; cart subtotal equals sampler total ($47.00); drawer opens
results.actual: sampler total=47.0, cart lines=3, subtotal=47.0, badge=3

results.title: Maximum pieces
results.expected: Count 9/9 and total equals sum of all prices ($149.25)
results.actual: state=('9 / 9 pieces selected', 149.25). Note: each product is selectable once and the catalog has exactly 9 products, so the 9-piece cap can never block a selection.

results.title: Wholesale landing and CTA
results.steps: Open /b2b, click Start a Custom Order
results.expected: Services listed; CTA opens wizard step 1

results.title: Quote reference stable; direct visit
results.steps: Toggle language on confirmation; open /b2b/confirmation directly in a new session
results.expected: Reference does not change; direct visit does not claim a request was received
results.actual: ref None -> None; direct visit shows reference=True

results.title: Empty and whitespace-only submission
results.steps: Submit empty; submit with spaces only
results.expected: Name, email and message errors in both cases
results.actual: empty -> ['Name is required.', 'Email is required.', 'Message is required.']; whitespace -> ['Name is required.', 'Email is required.', 'Message is required.']

results.title: Invalid values
results.expected: Three specific error messages; no submission
results.actual: errors=['Name can only contain letters, spaces, hyphens, and apostrophes.', 'Enter a valid email address.', 'Message must be at least 10 characters.']

results.title: Valid submission (mock)
results.steps: Name "María José", valid email, category Wholesale, 20+ char message
results.expected: Success message replaces form. Mock: nothing is transmitted (email bridge is Phase 3)

results.title: EN/ES toggle and <html lang>
results.steps: Click language toggle; check lang, nav and hero; toggle back
results.expected: lang="es", Spanish nav/hero; returns to lang="en"
results.actual: lang=es, nav=['Tienda', 'Mayoreo', 'Crea tu Muestrario', 'Contacto', 'Nosotros'], h1="Chocolate de Origen Único, Elaborado con", after toggle back lang=en
